# entry_point    The public entry point the member is generated through.
# member         The representative input, named as in tests/native_determinism.zig.
# optimize_mode  `debug` or `release_safe`. Inlining decides how many machine
#                call sites one source call site becomes, so the count is only
#                comparable within a mode. Measured in both because a gate that
#                is skipped in a mode passes vacuously there (cgz-r20).
# minimum_sites  A FLOOR, not an equality. The gate fails when the measured
# ## Why a floor rather than the allocation count
# checkAllocationFailures already sweeps every allocation INDEX and proves each
# one is reported and cleaned. That cannot see coverage shrinking: a
# representative input that stops reaching a module still passes its sweep - it
# just silently stops testing that module. This table is the ratchet against
# that, which is why SUCCESS_CRITERIA calls for it in as many words: without
# ## Why a floor rather than an exact number
# A decrease is the regression the criterion names, and it fails here. An
# increase is coverage growing and is allowed, so a change that reaches more of
# the tree does not have to touch this file to land. The addresses themselves
# are deliberately never recorded: they are not stable across builds and would
# Measured on aarch64-macos with the toolchain.lock pin, 0.17.0-dev.1516+8a4b5424d.
